Catalog conformance vectors of DEVICE-EXCHANGE vendored for the exchange server's tests (specification 252, item T-1).

These files are byte-for-byte copies of corpora the contracts catalog holds under device-exchange/vectors/ and that this
product has adopted by reference. They are never edited and never generated here: cmd/exchange-vectors writes only
testdata/vectors/. A hand edit changes a hash below and fails TestTheVendoredCatalogCorporaAreWhatTheProvenanceLists
(cmd/exchange-vectors/catalog_test.go); to take a newer catalog corpus, copy it again and replace its line.
.gitattributes in this folder switches line-ending conversion off so a Windows checkout keeps the bytes.

The columns are: SHA-256, the path under testdata/catalog/, the catalog-relative source path. Every file of this folder
except this one and .gitattributes has exactly one line. The catalog's own PROVENANCE.txt of each fmsw-* folder is copied
as it is; it names the hashes of the whole generated set (records, protection and connection-string included) of which
the catalog keeps only the files below.
